implementation: Original local CSS inspired by the public theme colors and desktop controls. No Poolsuite scripts, images or fonts are redistributed.

mint.role: primary action, quota and second assumed reset

rose-deep.role: first reset curve and lane label (5.25:1 on cream)

teal-deep.role: second reset curve and lane label (5.02:1 on cream)

principles: Pink desktop, cream windows, mint main actions and quota; yellow banked resets.
Small window corners, thin dark outlines, one-pixel inset control highlights; no paper noise or decorative animation.
Forecasts keep 1.2px curves; the second also uses dashes. All probability and time geometry stays unchanged.
Dark readable text on pastel surfaces; red is a risk border or underline, not small text.

UI labels, controls, dates, numeric inputs and chart annotations share locally hosted VT323 ASCII under SIL OFL. Chinese uses consistent system fallbacks; long explanations and source quotes use the reading-text role. Typography roles are managed in retro-desktop.css.
